name: armada
description: Organizational deployment layer. Four invocable setup skills in run order: armada (status and router), armada-brand (branding, run first), armada-department (activate a department), armada-connect (vendor connectors). Behind them: 11 department agents (data, design, engineering, finance, HR, IT ops, M365, product, productivity, security, support) and 156 department skills with org branding, policies, and compliance context. Install alongside atlas for org use.
